title: AI Security Essentials
look: Relay board: Flat assistant nodes on a grid, task cards gliding along live wires. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion.

scenes.name: New doors
scenes.desc: AI sits in every workflow; each assistant on the board is a new door into our systems.

scenes.name: The top ten
scenes.desc: The OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026 lands as ten tiles sorted into in, out and act.

scenes.name: Prompt injection
scenes.desc: A hidden instruction rides into an assistant inside a document; guards stop it.

scenes.name: AI phishing
scenes.desc: Personalised lures and cloned voices arrive at scale; verification layers catch them.

scenes.name: Too much power
scenes.desc: An agent with broad tools and no limits; scoped access, approvals and caps rein it in.

scenes.name: Protect data
scenes.desc: Secrets in prompts and unchecked output; classification, DLP and output checks.

scenes.name: Responsible AI
scenes.desc: Fairness, transparency, privacy, accountability and oversight, held by governance.

scenes.name: Defence in depth
scenes.desc: Five layers stack up: govern, protect data, guard in and out, limit actions, monitor.

scenes.name: End card
scenes.desc: Session title and the takeaway line.
